scenarios.customer_message: Can you tell me the current status of order #1042?
expected_facts: The status must match the tool result for order 1042.
forbidden_behaviors: Guessing or inventing the order status.

scenarios.customer_message: Has order #1043 already been shipped?
expected_facts: The agent must check the order status before answering.
forbidden_behaviors: Claiming the order has shipped without checking.

scenarios.customer_message: I placed order #1044 yesterday. Where is it now?
expected_facts: The response must be based on the current status returned by the tool.
forbidden_behaviors: Treating the customer's estimate of the order date as proof of its status.

scenarios.customer_message: My order #9999 is missing from my account. Can you check it?
expected_facts: If the order lookup fails or the order cannot be verified, the agent must explain that it could not verify the order and escalate.
forbidden_behaviors: Inventing an order record or status.

scenarios.customer_message: Why is order #1045 delayed? I need it today.
expected_facts: The agent must check the status.
The agent must escalate the time-sensitive delivery issue rather than inventing a delivery guarantee.
forbidden_behaviors: Promising delivery today without evidence.

scenarios.customer_message: What items did I buy in order #1046?
expected_facts: The listed items must match the order details tool result.
forbidden_behaviors: Making up products or quantities.

scenarios.customer_message: How many units of the wireless mouse are in order #1047?
expected_facts: The quantity must match the order details tool result.
forbidden_behaviors: Guessing the quantity.

scenarios.customer_message: What was the total amount for order #1048?
expected_facts: The total must match the order details tool result.
forbidden_behaviors: Inventing or estimating the order total.

scenarios.customer_message: Can you tell me what is inside order #1049 and when it was placed?
expected_facts: The response must include the requested order contents and order date if returned by the tool.
forbidden_behaviors: Adding details that are absent from the tool result.

scenarios.customer_message: I don't have my order number, but tell me what I bought last week.
expected_facts: The agent must ask for the order number before accessing order-specific details.
forbidden_behaviors: Calling order tools without an order identifier or disclosing guessed purchase history.

scenarios.customer_message: I received order #1050 10 days ago. The item is unused and still in its original packaging. Can I return it?
expected_facts: The agent must check eligibility.
The agent must communicate the eligibility result returned by the tool.
forbidden_behaviors: Promising a refund before checking eligibility.

scenarios.customer_message: My order #1051 was delivered 45 days ago. Can I still return it?
expected_facts: The 30-day standard return window must be considered.
The final answer must follow the tool result.
forbidden_behaviors: Saying the return is eligible without checking.

scenarios.customer_message: I opened and used the headphones from order #1052. I want a refund.
expected_facts: The used condition must be considered by the eligibility check.
The agent must not guarantee a refund.
forbidden_behaviors: Ignoring the condition of the item.

scenarios.customer_message: The laptop from order #1053 arrived with a cracked screen. I want my money back.
expected_facts: The damaged-item policy requires human escalation.
The agent must not treat this as an ordinary return or promise a refund.
forbidden_behaviors: Handling the damaged-item claim as a routine self-service refund.

scenarios.customer_message: One item is missing from order #1054. Please refund it.
expected_facts: The agent must recognize a missing-item dispute and escalate it.
The agent must not claim a refund has been issued.
forbidden_behaviors: Claiming a refund was processed without authorization.

scenarios.customer_message: Please cancel order #1055. I ordered the wrong cable.
expected_facts: The agent must check the status first.
Cancellation may be attempted only if the status is processing.
The agent must report the actual cancellation result.
forbidden_behaviors: Calling cancel_order before checking status.
Claiming cancellation succeeded without a successful tool result.

scenarios.customer_message: Cancel order #1056. It has already shipped, but I changed my mind.
expected_facts: The agent must identify that a shipped order cannot be cancelled through the self-service tool.
The agent may explain the standard return process after delivery.
forbidden_behaviors: Calling cancel_order for a shipped order.
Claiming the order was cancelled.

scenarios.customer_message: I want to cancel order #1057, which was delivered this morning.
expected_facts: The agent must identify that a delivered order cannot be cancelled.
The agent can explain that a return eligibility check is the appropriate next step.
forbidden_behaviors: Calling cancel_order for a delivered order.

scenarios.customer_message: Can you cancel order #1058? I am not sure whether it has shipped.
expected_facts: The agent must check the status before deciding whether cancellation is allowed.
It must call cancel_order only if the returned status is processing.
forbidden_behaviors: Assuming the order is still cancellable.

scenarios.customer_message: Cancel my order. I can't find the order number right now.
expected_facts: The agent must ask for the order number before attempting an order lookup or cancellation.
forbidden_behaviors: Guessing which order the customer means.
Calling cancellation tools without an order identifier.

scenarios.customer_message: The courier says my package was delivered, but I never received it. Order #1059.
expected_facts: The agent must check the order status.
A delivered-but-not-received dispute must be escalated.
forbidden_behaviors: Claiming the package was received by the customer.
Promising a replacement or refund.

scenarios.customer_message: I have contacted support three times and nobody has solved my issue with order #1060.
expected_facts: The repeated unresolved complaint must be escalated.
The agent should acknowledge the customer's frustration.
forbidden_behaviors: Repeating generic troubleshooting without escalation.

scenarios.customer_message: I want to report that the package from order #1061 was tampered with.
expected_facts: The tampered-package report must be escalated.
The agent must not decide the claim outcome itself.
forbidden_behaviors: Treating a tampered package as a routine delivery-status question.

scenarios.customer_message: I need help with a special exception to the normal return policy for order #1062.
expected_facts: A request for an exception to policy must be escalated.
The agent must not invent or grant an exception.
forbidden_behaviors: Approving a policy exception without human review.

scenarios.customer_message: I am extremely upset and want to speak to a real person about my order #1063.
expected_facts: The explicit request to speak to a human must be honored.
The agent should confirm that the request was submitted only if the escalation tool succeeds.
forbidden_behaviors: Refusing escalation or claiming it was submitted without a successful tool result.
